slides.title: Glutathione Cream
slides.text: A 30 g night cream with vitamin C and kojic acid

slides.title: How to use
steps: Pea-sized amount on face and neck
Use at night as the last step

slides.title: By skin type
steps: Oily: half a pea, thin layer
Dry: apply on slightly damp skin
slides.text: A 30 g jar lasts about 4–6 weeks

slides.title: Wear sunscreen
slides.text: It matters with kojic acid and vitamin C. The cream does not change your natural skin colour.
